items.title: Skyblock Worlds
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Skyblock worlds?! I can see them from the spaceship. Is that one frozen? That one looks like it's burning! What do these worlds contain? Survive and have fun!

+ 7 worlds!
+ 2 spaceships to explore!
+ Find secret chests and many ores!
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Prison Escape
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Be Careful! A strange virus has infected this prison. Zombies are everywhere. Find keys and get to the chopper and escape!

items.title: Isle Of Dinotopia
items.creator: Team Phoenix Studio
items.description: Come walk amongst the Dinosaurs. Some you can live inside and make your own home. Survival spawn with paths marked out, ready for your survival expedition.

items.title: Rainbow Teens
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These cute and colorful teens look like a rainbow. Cheer everyone around you up with this cute skin pack!

by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Camo Blocks: Bed Wars
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Do you love 'Bed Wars'? Be the ultimate stealth ninja and hide from your friends with this camouflage skin set! Perfect for any pro!

- 11 camo skins!
- Multiple bed and wool colors!

items.title: Animatronic Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
There's something wrong with these animatronic mobs... scary! It's lucky they don't move on their own... right? Maybe we should block them inside... just in case!

- 8 terrifying skins!
- Pick from Creeper, Enderman, Skeleton, Zombie, and many more!

items.title: Green Day
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Gotta love mother nature! Keep the planet clean! Remind yourself and everyone around to protect the environment with the color green!
- 12 roleplay skins!
- Modern attire inspired by recycling and the color green!

items.title: Mighty Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
There are no rules of architecture for a castle in the clouds. If you dream about it, you can have it. 
Explore the mighty castle of the past and live like a mighty warrior.

- Stunning survival spawn
- Includes big farms
- By RareLoot

items.title: Neko Demons
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Show off your horns! Team up with the most anime addicted demons in the city and show off your demon spirit! These teens are the coolest in the city and love to hunt scary mobs! Protect your Minecraft world with these Neko Demon teens! 

+ 12 devilish teen skins!
+ Modern and scary fashion!
+ Hunt scary mobs with these skins!

items.title: Anime Spy Teens
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Have you ever dreamt to become a secret agent? What about an manga addicted spy? Say no more, these teens watch anime all day and study their opponent's moves. Anime Spy Teens can execute secret missions and destroy city villains with ease! Join the stealthy gang and team up to defeat those pesky villains!

+ 12 anime-themed skins!
+ Super stealthy!
+ Top secret agents!

items.title: Invincible Warriors
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The invincible warriors have arrived to the marketplace, always victorious and honorable, are you ready to defeat all your enemies?

-12 Skins
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Cops and Robbers: Jailbreak
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
There’s been a jailbreak! The robbers have escaped their cells and are making their escape. However, the cops have set countless traps in order to stop them. Join the robbers in their escape or try to stop them as the warden! 

- Fast-paced Cops and Robbers themed parkour map!
- Many unique types of traps!
- Multiplayer PvP and parkour map!

items.title: Ultimate Robots HD
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Ultimate Robots have arrived in the marketplace and in the highest resolution, ready for combat with the best technology in the universe.

-8 HD Skins
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Nether Horrors
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These Nether horrors are creepy and scary! Join them in the darkness and flames of the Nether. Become one evil creature of the night and rule the Nether with your claws! Are you a pro at navigating the Nether?

- 5 Nether skins

items.title: Dog Park
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Woof woof! The puppers are super excited about a trip to the park today! Who doesn't love dogs? They make amazing friends and are loyal companions. Who can resist those soulful, puppy eyes! Make sure you show your canine lots of love! Or even become one today with these skins!

- 11 dog skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Top 10 Pirates
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Ahoy! Yarr, it be that time o’ the pirating season: when we crown the lords and ladys and royalty of all the scallywags and sea dogs that ever sailed under the jolly roger! Fire your cannons to show your support for Blackbeard, Ching Shih, Long John Silver, Anne Bonny, Jack Sparrow, and raise yer flag with these 10 brave buccaneer skins in their same image!

items.title: Top 10 Pros
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Ever wonder what it’s like to do one of the top jobs out there? Why not try one of these on for size?
Doctor, baker, police officer! These professionals are ready for everything from the fire station to the surgery room.
Check out our top ten skins showing off the best the professional world has to offer!

items.title: Animal Pajamas
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for the animal pajama sleepover? These cute Minecraft skins are perfect for any slumber party!

by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Masked
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Don't show your face! Wear a mask and travel anonymously yet confidently!
Show off your style in the brand new fashion trend: masks!

+8 Unique skins!
+1 FREE skin!
+Includes a lot of unique masks!

items.title: PvP Pros
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you like to play player versus player? Want to show everyone that you’re a pro? Then come and join the 'PvP Pros'! With these skins, you can show everyone who the real champion is!

- 8 PVP skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: High School Demons
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Even demons have to go to school! Join the demon squad and haunt the hallways and classrooms! Ghostly fun awaits you during lunch break with these ghoulishly amazing skins.

- 12 demon skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Teen Pro-Gamer 3
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you want to be a professional player? Show your friends that you are the real MVP? Then Teen Pro-Gamer 3 is the skin pack you need! The third and newest installment in this skin series brings you 10 new amazing skins!

- By RareLoot

items.title: One Block Sky Survival
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Team Workbench presents: One Block Sky Survival! Play One Block Sky Survival and discover 18 islands. Each island has its own material generator. Unlock new islands by trading with the villagers. Can you unlock all the 18 islands?

+ 18 islands
+ 18 material generators
+ Licensed by Team Workbench and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Noob Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Noob Base! Are you ready to step into the noob house? Try to survive one night in the noob house and you're a lucky player! Many rooms for exploration and survival.

- Potion room
- Farms
- Chest room
- Nether room
- 6 HD skins
- Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.
